key_reasoning.reason: Touches the shared native-installer utility (new PowerShell install path: isPowerShellInstallerUrl, buildPowerShellInstallerArgs, describeWindowsPowerShellFailure, install.cmd cleanup) and the Kimi plugin (Windows verifyPath, KIMI_VERSION env var, .ps1 installer URL). The shared utility is also used by other agents.

Downloads and runs a remote script in memory via powershell irm/iex. No exact precedent in the repo, because the existing Windows path is .cmd-based. Injection surface: URL HTTPS and single-quote checks, version validation and the env-var version pass-through. Execution-policy handling and step-attributed failure messages add Windows-specific edge cases.
